newsitem.title: LATVIA: Hansabank Latvija May profit 140,200 lats. [CORRECTED 08:50 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Hansabank Latvija May profit 140,200 lats. [CORRECTED 08:50 GMT]

text.p: Hansabank Latvija, a subsidiary of Estonia's Hansapank, had a net profit of 140,200 lats in May compared to 152,000 lats in April, Hansapank said on Monday.
Hansabank Latvija's current year profit was 592,300 lats at the end of May, Hansapank added in a statement.
(Corrects current year profit figure from 3.9 million lats).
Hansabank Latvija's total assets decreased by 513,700 lats or 0.8 percent in May to 66.8 million lats.
Deposits decreased by 12.7 million lats or 23.4 percent to 41.5 million lats. The loan portfolio grew by 8.9 percent or 1.8 million lats, amounting to 21.7 million lats.
At the end of May, the share of net loans in total assets was 31.5 percent.
The bank's securities trading portfolio fell by 1.7 million lats or 29.7 percent to four million lats. Its securities investment portfolio rose by 6.6 million lats to 15.2 million lats.
Hansabank Latvija's market share by total assets was 5.62 percent at the end of April.
